title: Майже все добре
body:
Додаток один з найкращих у своїй категорії. Але має два мінуси:
1. Відсутня українська мова
2. Велика ціна підписки, тим більшого одноразова покупка 99$

Якщо автор вирішить ці питання, то я одразу куплю пожиттєво. І звісно зміню свою оцінку та відгук
author: YaroslavSherstyuk

title: Last update issues
body:
I’ve been using this app for quite a while and was rather happy in general, however the last update brought up 2 issues: when you’re listening to the music and open an app, the music stops playing which is super annoying; app loading time has significantly increased which is not crucial but still irritating. 

Please try to fix both issues as they’re making a user experience much worse. 

Best regards
author: Andrew_Richard

title: The best app for tracking goals ever
body: This app gives you a variety of options to track your goals. I guess, it covers literally all the scenarios. Also it has super handy Apple Health integration!
author: Tex1712

title: Can’t choose unit for habit
body: Hi! The App is great but why you didn’t make choice to track time or distance etc. For example I want reading at least 30min per day and running 20 km per week. Then I want to see how many time in fact I had read last month, how many kms etc. I really need the unit for habits.
author: m3teqs

title: No undos, some of functions doesn’t work correctly
body: If u swipe wrong there is no way to undo the progress on the task (“yes” works, “no” doesn’t). Maybe there is some other way to undo it (hidden so I can’t understand how to do it) but I don’t like it at all and it bothers me. I’m still on trial of the app but this bugs really keep me away from long term purchase.
author: VShumskaya

title: Just unusable
body: Statistics page has incorrectly calculated pace value. Projected date suddenly changes to a completely different . Application lives it’s own life, it does need user. Too rough bugs, looks like app is very poorly tested and maintained. Wanted to buy a subscription, but removed.

title: Great app!
body: That would be really great if you add more gamification in process and more so called prizes for achievements:)

body:

body:

author: Drear1ness

title: Buggy and developers don't care
body: The developers are aware about the annoying notifications bug at least for three weeks and don't bother to issue a patched update. Highly disappointed. The app looked very promising.
author: OlgaCh

title: Thanks to developers
body: Awesome application. I'm using free version, it's enough for me, and it's completely comfortable for those functions it's necessary for. Thanks!

title: The best ever!
body: The best ever habit tracker and goal tracker i've used! Tried so many before! This one is the greatest!
